THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, SATURDAY, JULY 21, 1923.

CHINESE COMMUNIST
MANIFESTO

A General Criticism of All Poli-
tical Parties in the Country

FOREIGN POWERS AND
THE MILITARISTS

We have just received from the
executive committee at Canton of
the Communist Party in China, a
very interesting statement of their
views and stand in connexion
with the present political situa-
tion.

After dealing with the history
of China's political troubles and
Tsao Kun's coup d'etat, resulting
in the overthrow of Li Yuan-
hung, the statement says that the
coup was effected with help from
Americans and the pro-American
Christian general, Feng Yu-
hsing. With the support of the
diplomatic party, Tsao hoped for
financial assistance from America.
He dared to expel Li only because
he was backed by American power
and the result is a victory for
American imperialism. All
enemies of the Chihli clique who
desire to play with Li Yuan-hung
as a toy want to escort him to
Mukden or Hangchow and have
him continue as nominal Pre-
sident.

The Tuan Chi-jui group of An-
fuists is irreconcilable, states the
paper, but their crimes are known
to the world. They wish to utilize
the people's hatred to regain their
lost power. Bowing to Tuan is
the same as bowing to other Chih-
li parties. The Anfu and Chihli
parties are backed by imperial-
ists, but a victory by either of
them would do nothing for the
benefit of China. Neither will be
recognized by the people.

Shameless and Greedy M. P's.

In connexion with Parliament,
the statement says: "The shame-
less, greedy and rough members of
Parliament are fed by Tsao Kun
for a long time. If there are
honest and clean elements among
them why did they not come to the
foreground? The organizations of
merchants, students and workers
have expressively denied the right
of the Parliament to represent the
people. Which elements of the
people are represented by the Par-
liament? The proposal to remove
it to the south is a proposal con-
tradictory to the opinion of the
people. When the Parliament
will finish the Constitution and
elect the President, the people will
declare that the decisions of the
Parliament are valueless."

The southwestern generals come
in for their share also. They are
accused of maintaining big armies
for suppressing the rights of the
people and making fortunes in a
manner which is no better than
that of the Chihli militarists.

Nominally they want to establish
a federation of autonomous pro-
vinces, but actually they want to
establish a federation of tuchuns.

The writers then state: "The
creation of an independent state
and the establishment of a revolu-
tionary government need the
efforts of the people and many
hardships and much suffering.
We cannot follow the example of
some Korean nationalists, who
claimed recognition at the Ver-
sailles and Washington Confer-
ences, by which help they hoped to
succeed, but who did not endea-
vour to make the revolution. The
militarists who have made their
combinations with the Foreign
Powers are hated by us. But,
many who hate these militarists'
try to secure support from the
Powers to break the power of the
militarists. People who cannot
understand the close co-operation
between the militarists and for-
eign imperialists cannot create an
independent and autonomous
state. On the contrary we de-
mand only a government created
by the people's own efforts, a
government created by the revolu-
tion. The people can never re-
cognize a government made and
controlled by any imperialist
state."

After urging the people to fight
against Tsao Kun and to hold a
national congress composed of de-
legates from the chambers of
commerce, agricultural unions,
student unions and other profes-
sional unions of the whole coun-
try at a suitable place, under the
auspices of the Kuomintang, this
congress to take upon itself the
task of drafting the constitution,
the unification of the country and
the establishment of a new Chin-
ese Government, the statement
reads:--

"The new government, born out
of the National Congress, with
real revolutionary nationalist
force, will crush the power of the
militarists of the whole of China
and also of the foreign imperial-
ists behind them. This Govern-
ment will not be a local govern-
ment, but will really be qualified
as a People's Government; it will
not be a government of co-operat-
ing militarists under the control
of foreign imperialists.

"Brethren, this is the only way
to save the Chinese from the two-
fold suppression of the militarists
and the foreign Powers.

"Down with the Imperialist
Powers, which utilize the
militarists for exploitation
of China!

"Down with the militarists, who
co-operate with the foreign
Powers for the suppression
of the people!

"National Revolutionists of
whole China, unite!"

中国共产党宣言

对全国各政党之总批评

列强与军阀

我们刚刚收到中国共产党广州执行委员会发来的一份声明，其中就当前政治局势阐述了他们的观点和立场，颇有意思。

在回顾了中国政治动荡的历史以及导致黎元洪下台的曹锟政变之后，该声明称，此次政变得到了美国人及亲美的基督教将军冯玉祥的帮助。曹锟在外交系的的支持下，希望从美国获得财政援助。他之所以敢于驱逐黎元洪，完全是因为有美国势力做后盾，其结果是美国帝国主义的胜利。所有直系军阀的敌人，那些想把黎元洪当作玩物的人，都想把他护送到沈阳或杭州，让他继续担任名义上的总统。

该文件称，段祺瑞为首的安福系集团是不可调和的，但他们的罪行已为世人所知。他们希望利用人民的仇恨来重获失去的权力。向段祺瑞低头等同于向其他直系派系低头。安福系和直系都有帝国主义支持，但他们任何一方获胜都不会给中国带来任何好处。人民也不会承认他们中的任何一方。

无耻且贪婪的议员

关于国会，该声明称：“国会议员无耻、贪婪且粗鄙，长期受曹锟豢养。如果其中确有诚实清廉之士，为何他们不挺身而出？商会、学生会和工人组织已明确否认国会代表人民的权利。国会究竟代表了人民的哪些阶层？将国会南迁的提议违背了民意。当国会完成宪法制定并选举总统时，人民将宣布国会的决定毫无价值。”

西南地区的将领们也受到了批评。他们被指责维持庞大军队以压制人民权利，并以并不比直系军阀更高明的手段敛财。

名义上他们希望建立联省自治，但实际上他们想建立的是督军联盟。

作者随后陈述道：“建立独立国家和革命政府需要人民的努力，需经历许多艰难困苦。我们不能效仿某些韩国民族主义者，他们在凡尔赛和华盛顿会议上寻求承认，指望借此获得成功，却未致力于革命。我们与那些与列强勾结的军阀势不两立。但是，许多憎恨这些军阀的人却试图寻求列强的支持以打破军阀的势力。无法理解军阀与外国帝国主义之间密切合作的人，无法建立独立自主的国家。相反，我们只要求一个由人民自身努力创造的政府，一个由革命创造的政府。人民永远不会承认由任何帝国主义国家制造和控制的政府。”

在呼吁人民对抗曹锟，并在国民党主持下，于适当地点召开由全国商会、农会、学生会及其他职业团体代表组成的国民大会之后——该大会将承担起草宪法、统一国家和建立新中国政府的任务——声明写道：

“诞生于国民大会的新政府，凭借真正的革命民族主义力量，将粉碎全中国军阀及其背后外国帝国主义的势力。这个政府不会是地方政府，而是真正有资格称为‘人民政府’；它不会是受外国帝国主义控制的军阀合作政府。

“同胞们，这是使中国人摆脱军阀和列强双重压迫的唯一途径。

“打倒利用军阀剥削中国的帝国主义列强！

“打倒与列强勾结镇压人民的军阀！

“全中国的国民革命者，联合起来！”

5214
1923年7月24日。
